long_biography.plain_text:
The Greek Technical Committee at ClassNK became one of the places where Marios Stafylopatis turned operating experience into industry service. As its chairman, he led twice-yearly meetings of about 70 technical directors and specialists, creating a forum for examining new regulation and engineering developments across Greek shipping. His background in marine engineering and naval architecture gave that role an unusually practical footing.

The same emphasis on applied knowledge shaped Byzantine Maritime's training work in Manila. The company developed courses for seafarers alongside bridge, engine and cargo-handling simulators, combining recruitment with long-term professional development. Stafylopatis presented the centre not merely as an internal resource but as a way to raise capability across the wider maritime workforce.

uncertainties.detail: The owner record uses Stafylopatis, while ClassNK and several English-language shipping sources use Stafilopatis. Greek reporting gives the surname as Σταφυλοπάτης, confirming that the two Latin spellings refer to the same uncommon Greek name. The dossier preserves the owner record's display spelling.

Stafylopatis told ClassNK that he and his brother established the company in 1967, while Byzantine Maritime's official history says operations began in the early 1970s and Mononews gives 1970. The biographies therefore state that he co-founded the company without publishing a disputed exact year.

The reviewed evidence shows that Marios and Francis established Byzantine Maritime themselves, but it also documents their father's earlier shipping activity and a broader maritime family platform. Self-made — advantaged start is used because no reviewed source establishes an inheritance or transfer of Byzantine Maritime itself.
Mononews reports a 1949 birth year, supported by the age references in ClassNK and the source record. No reliable source reviewed provides a birth month or day, so neither is proposed.

A LinkedIn directory contains a minimal Marios Stafilopatis listing in Greece, but it exposes no career anchors sufficient to verify that profile as this shipping founder. No personal LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube, TikTok or personal website reached the identity threshold.
No dedicated Forbes profile was found under the source spelling, the common English transliterations or the Greek spelling. No Forbes social is proposed.
